description: For every subset \(S\) of \(\mathbb N\), some function on naturals with a new top \(\ell\) satisfies \(F(0)=\varnothing\) and \(F(n+1)=F(n)\cup\{n\}\) while assigning \(F(\ell)=S\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.successor_rules_leave_top_free (s : Set ℕ) :
  ∃ F, F 0 = ∅ ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), F ↑(n + 1) = F ↑n ∪ {n}) ∧ F ⊤ = s
